detail: She joins at about Lv 15: Priest at Lv 20 (Ch 8) with White Magic C.
EXP: she heals in every dungeon party next to Jasmine; each cast trains White too.
Pay her before the Mons Silver Shields: Jasmine's Shield can wait.

detail: Joins at about Lv 15 (Soldier); she takes Dadao's Hammer and slot 8 in Ch 9.
Run [[place:Valhalla Mine]] with her now: Lv 20 for Armored Knight before Ch 9.

detail: Io's Levin Sword goes to Sirocco for the armored Ch 10 map.

explore.text: Clear any Ch 6 dungeon you skipped first, then these
Dungeon party (5): Jasmine and Fianna in every run, Esmeralda from her recruit
detail: Two carries take the last seats; feed the kills to the Lv 15 joins.
Jasmine wants Lv 20 now (Armored Knight), Fianna by Ch 8 (Priest).

detail: Also Large Bullion and an [[item:Antitoxin]].
[[item:Azaga's Bow]] is cursed (Curse 2): hold it to the end of Part I (Drifting Reliquary).
Mine its crystals: Blue Snoll for Inyoni's Da Mina Bow +2 (Ch 9).
